note: Fixed before any new data were scored with a similarity score. Any later change is a deviation.

score.name: F_plus
score.S: 1 - mean |x - y| over reference samples, raw beta
score.E: Codex E: (dCor^2 - q0) / (1 - q0), floored at 0; q0 = tr(A) tr(B) / ((n - 1) sqrt(sum A^2 sum B^2))

reliability_flags.pair_rule: flagged if either site is flagged
reliability_flags.use: reported beside the score, never multiplied in

shared_test_design.matched_error: 6 evenly spaced levels over the middle 80% of the overlap of the two curves (fold means)

halves.sequencing: first vs second half of each chromosome by position

step2_tcga_450k.pairs: 380,355 filtered probes, autosomes, hg38 CpG position = Zhou CpG_beg + 1, each probe with the next on the same chromosome

H1.holds_if: F beats F-no-distance in > 50% of cells

H3.claim: dCor beats shrunk Spearman inside New C

H4.holds_if: |F_plus - F| < 0.0005 in both outcomes at every ell

H6.holds_if: higher error and lower gain at matched spread (20 bins), worse in >= 12/20 bins on both, for not_unique, poor_mapping, SINE

step2_tcga_450k.replicates_if: rule holds genome-wide and in both halves

step3_outlier_replication.flags: Task 13 external-reference OutlierMeth flags, 53 Alive normals, autosomal probes with non-missing flags
step3_outlier_replication.neighbours: previous and next probe with flags, hg38 order, same chromosome; flagged = same sample and direction, no floor on the neighbour
step3_outlier_replication.similarity: F_plus on the 32 Dead normals, ell = 200
step3_outlier_replication.outcome: matched tumour flag at the same probe, same direction; excess = replicated - share of the other 52 tumours with a same-direction flag

rules.run: >= 3 consecutive flagged probes, same sample and direction, each step <= 1000 bp (epimutacions)
rules.similarity: >= 1 flagged neighbour with F_plus >= 0.5, any distance

step3_outlier_replication.support_score: max F_plus over flagged neighbours, 0 if none
step3_outlier_replication.primary_test: top K flags by similarity support (K = run-rule set size, ties split evenly) vs run-rule flags, difference in mean excess replication

step2b_public_sequencing.selection: human RRBS/WGBS, >= 15 samples of one tissue or cell type from different people, per-CpG methylated and total counts, open access; prefer hg38 and read-level files
step2b_public_sequencing.sites: coverage >= 10 in every sample (>= 5 if < 10,000 truly consecutive pairs remain)
step2b_public_sequencing.hypotheses: H1-H6 as step 2; H7: depth-weighted S (weight = smaller read count of the two sites) beats F_plus at matched error in > 50% of cells in both halves

step4_shared_reads.linkage: share of reads covering both sites with the same state minus p_i p_j + (1 - p_i)(1 - p_j), pairs within 200 bp, >= 10 spanning reads
step4_shared_reads.H8: mean linkage > 0 and falls with distance
step4_shared_reads.H9: among low-spread pairs (one site has no sample > 0.1 from its median), above-median linkage pairs have higher held-out prediction gain than below-median, in both halves
